summary: Created a 4-phase implementation plan for the git-add gitignore-advisory false-negative defect. Phase 1 replaces git-commit-scoped.sh's blind `if ! git add` guard with captured-output plus per-positive-pathspec index-state verification (git ls-files --error-unmatch + git diff --quiet with the :(exclude) entries passed through), tolerating the advisory exit 1 while still refusing a genuine nothing-staged failure with exit 2. Phases 2-4 add six regression cases plus a negative control to the existing test suite, record the positive-pathspec hazard in git-staging-scope.md, and run the full gate set with baseline-vs-post failure attribution. Waves: [1], [2,3], [4]; 3.25 hours estimated.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan: post-add index-state verification at the git add step, regression coverage, staging-scope standards subsection, full-gate close-out.
